decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Before the development commences full details of the lock gates/bridge across Soaphouse Creek shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA.  Details of the pedestrian bridge from the main development to Lots Ait including appropriate screening shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to implementation of the Lots Ait plan as set out in the section 106 agreement which includes a timetable by which the plan must be implemented.  Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved schemes.
description: Following approval for demolition of existing and redevelopment of site for mixed commercial/residential use part details submitted pursuant to Condition 53 (lock gates and pedestrian access) - variation of wording of approved permission reference number 00443/G/P3 dated 06/07/1999.
